dedupe_keys.name: visual language reasoning segmentation of function level building footprint buff dataset

description: The BUFF team publishes a Shenzhen building-function benchmark derived from government survey polygons and 2022 imagery. Zenodo lists an open archive and a four-page guide under CC BY 4.0. The provider describes approximately 500,000 buildings assigned a primary function, paired with 0.5-metre Google Earth imagery and cropped into 12,940 images of 512 by 512 pixels. The guide defines functions such as residential, education, government, hospital and factory, with a training, validation and test split of 9,056, 1,304 and 2,580 images. Building functions can improve daytime occupancy, service-exposure or land-use assumptions in city simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Shenzhen benchmark. A limitation is that labels describe primary use, so mixed-use floors are collapsed into one class. The archive was not opened to verify polygon and image formats. Zenodo states CC BY, but rights in upstream Google Earth imagery require separate review before pixel reuse or redistribution. No segmentation accuracy was checked.
